note: The order the product argues in. The deck copies this list rather than inventing its own, so the two artefacts cannot tell different stories.

steps.title: Why a limit exists at all
steps.question: A source at 400 AU shifts 997 arcsec over a 213 day baseline, and the cutout is 180 arcsec wide. Geometry, not brightness, sets the horizon.

steps.title: How deep the pipeline sees
steps.question: Completeness is measured by injection: 0.4 MJy/sr is recovered every time, 0.2 in 15 to 60 per cent of tries depending on the field.

steps.title: Whether it was actually searched
steps.question: Every rate was stacked and compared against an empirical null of 5,000 draws. The best stack falls below the 99.9th percentile, so no detection.

steps.title: What the search did find
steps.question: Sixteen sources the catalogue does not list and whose motion passes the test. Five share one displacement, which is a systematic and is reported as one.

steps.title: How to check all of it
steps.question: Seven claims, each with the SHA-256 of the file behind it, four of them marked as not present in the repository.
